stage: Annotation-assisted nuisance sensitivity diagnostic, no fitting and no efficacy claim.
hypothesis: One-original-pixel annotation-corner perturbations can reverse meaningful coordinate-action advantages on tiny targets, while some stable action improvements over the frozen uniform policy remain.

sample.rule: First128 fitting and first64 head-held-out images. Detector historically saw all train scenes. Only the head split is disjoint. No fresh data or independent confirmation is claimed.

replay: Reuse raw five-view captures. Rebuild calibrated candidates and coordinate menus with ignores=[]; apply frozen uniform head, then filter predictions by its final boxes' diagnostic ignore IoF. Require exact equality to candidate12 cached uniform predictions.
ownership: Score-ordered, same-class, one-to-one IoU>=0.5 ownership on the filtered original calibrated candidates at score>=0.001, fixed for every perturbation. Analyze owned rows at calibrated score>=0.05 with >=2 valid actions; exclude an anchor if any perturbed box has nonpositive width or height.
perturbation: Nominal GT plus all16 independent +-1 ORIGINAL-pixel corner combinations (x1,y1,x2,y2), clipped to image bounds. This is a finite corner sensitivity probe, not a certified uncertainty bound, a measured label-noise model or a robustness guarantee.
primary: On64 head-held-out images: tiny actions with nominal IoU improvement>0.01 over uniform whose minimum improvement across17 GT variants is<-0.01, divided by all nominally beneficial tiny actions. Also report a label-assisted stable oracle's owned small_all ten-IoU-threshold hit fraction gain over uniform.
stable_oracle: An alternative must beat the same uniform action by>0.01 at ALL17 variants. Among eligible actions choose highest NOMINAL IoU, otherwise keep uniform. Counts threshold hits at0.50:0.05:0.95 against nominal same-owned GT; no rematching. This uses labels and cannot deploy.
secondary: All valid unordered action pairs with nominal abs IoU gap>0.01: sign reversals and hard reversals at opposite gap>0.01 by size. Nominal/oracle/uniform threshold fractions, mean IoUs and stable-action prevalence.
pass_action: Only permits separately registering matched tiny-head pilots: ordinary ranking versus stable partial-order supervision and a matched randomly thinned ranking control. Frozen detector, geometry inputs and original inference action rule remain fixed.
fail_action: Stop this annotation-order recipe without adjusting pixel radius, thresholds or image list.
budget: 192 cached images, zero detector forwards, zero image crops, zero training. CPU replay and vectorized17x6 IoUs. No val/test-dev or official evaluator.
prior_art: TOLF arxiv2601.00617 already studies tiny annotation-noise sensitivity and uncertainty-guided optimization. RankDetNet, Rank&Sort and proposal ranking establish ranking priors. This diagnostic cannot establish novelty; specific partial-order supervision still needs closer robust-ranking comparisons.
limits: Synthetic corner nuisance need not match real annotation uncertainty. Ownership selection is biased toward already detected objects. Same-owned ten-threshold fraction is not detection AP/AR. Report all failures and retain prior STOP decisions.
